items.title: Job cuts are at a four-year low, according to Challenger data
items.summary: Job cuts are at a four-year low, according to Challenger Grey data illustrating the over 500,000 job cuts that have occurred in 2026 year-to-date. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and BD8 Capital Partners, LLC CEO Barbara Doran to take a closer look and this data discuss whether AI-driven job loss fears were initially overblown. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is scheduled to release August jobs data on Friday, September 4.

items.title: Uber Technologies (UBER) Cuts 3,300 Jobs As Investors Reassess Its Valuation
items.summary: Uber Technologies (UBER) has just announced a restructuring that will cut about 3,300 jobs, or roughly 10% of its global workforce, as it trims management layers and consolidates teams. For investors, the restructuring headlines are landing against a mixed share price backdrop, with a 30 day share price return of 6.76% and a year to date share price decline of 7.74%, while total shareholder return is down 17.74% over one year but still up over three and five years. items.title: Uber Is Cutting 10% of Its Workforce and Betting $10 Billion on Robotaxis Instead
items.summary: Uber is slashing thousands of jobs and pouring billions into self-driving cars it will never actually build. Whether that bet saves the company or slowly hands its future to someone else is the real question.

items.title: Vietnamese Rival To Uber, Lyft Plans To Enter U.S. Market This Year
items.summary: The VinFast-linked rideshare company GSM plans to enter the U.S. market by the end of this year, the company said.

items.title: Corporate America Is Axing the ‘Micro-Team’ Boss
items.summary: At Uber and elsewhere, managers with small fiefdoms have become an especially vulnerable target in the push to purge management ranks.
